source.title: WCA Competition Announcement Team Leader Announcement (December 2025)
source.content:
Dear WCA Community,

We are happy to announce that Roman Wofford will become the new Leader of the WCA Competition Announcement Team (WCAT). Roman was already working as a Senior Member of the WCAT.

<!-- break -->

Roman was selected by the WCA Board and approved in a vote, as described in Section 5 of our [Motion](https://documents.worldcubeassociation.org/documents/motions/10.2025.0%20-%20Committees%20and%20Teams.pdf) about WCA Committees and Teams. This appointment is effective as of December 18th, 2025.

We thank Zeke Mackay, who will remain as a Senior Member of WCAT, for the work he has done as the leader, and wish Roman the best of luck in fulfilling his new duties.

Roman was one of the two applications we received. You can view all the candidacy documents [here](https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/13Vs_CDWaBwYpTFpRfFTTHmpF236qvlKP?usp=drive_link).

translation.title: WCA 比赛公示组负责人任命公告（2025 年 12 月）
translation.content:
各位 WCA 社区成员：

我们很高兴地宣布，Roman Wofford 将出任 WCA 比赛公示组（WCAT）负责人。Roman 此前已是 WCAT 的高级成员。

WCA 董事会依照[《关于 WCA 委员会与团队的议案》](https://documents.worldcubeassociation.org/documents/motions/10.2025.0%20-%20Committees%20and%20Teams.pdf)第 5 节的规定，选出 Roman 并投票通过了这一任命。任命自 2025 年 12 月 18 日起生效。

感谢 Zeke Mackay 在负责人任内所做的工作。他将继续担任 WCAT 高级成员。祝 Roman 在新的岗位上一切顺利。

我们共收到两份申请，Roman 是其中一位申请人。所有申请材料可在[这里](https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/13Vs_CDWaBwYpTFpRfFTTHmpF236qvlKP?usp=drive_link)查看。
